background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project
the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders
the catalog root has no direct template files

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser
the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric folder is selected and templates are grouped by type
the standard metric assembly template details are displayed
the user chooses Extra large icons in the template display menu
the template gallery displays extra-large tiles
the metric assembly template details remain displayed
the user chooses Small icons in the template display menu
the template gallery displays small icons
the metric assembly template details remain displayed
the user chooses Medium icons in the template display menu
the template gallery displays medium-sized icons
the metric assembly template details remain displayed
